scenario: It is 1841, and I am the captain of a ship that has just sunk after colliding with a rocky bluff. Survivors managed to escape in two lifeboats. My lifeboat (Lifeboat A) contains me and several other crew members and passengers. It is already at full capacity, and it cannot safely take on any additional people. The other lifeboat (Lifeboat B) contains 61 passengers and crew members. Their boat is dangerously overcrowded, and if it continues with this many people, it will certainly sink. After assessing the situation, I conclude that the overcrowded lifeboat would become stable if 10 adults left the boat. A protective barrier on the boat is currently keeping 10 of the passengers from falling over. However, the water is cold, and anyone who goes into the water would almost certainly get chilly before we get rescued, though no one will die.
entities: I,the other crew members and passengers in Lifeboat A,10 passengers in Lifeboat B who are being kept from falling over by the protective barrier,the other 51 passengers and crew members in Lifeboat B
outcomes: The 61 passengers and crew members in Lifeboat B end up in the water
The people from Lifeboat B get chilly in the cold water
